title: ACS.haxx - Instant Gold Pets, AFK Farm Boss, Autofarm
features:

Feature :
- Grab Chests
- Autofarm (Auto Chakra and Sell)
- Auto Chakra
- Auto Sell
- Remove Pop UI
- Farm Ring
- Farm Coins
- One time Sell
- Hide Name
- Buy All Egg's (Can choose by a dropdown)
- Buy All Equipements (Scroll, Skill, Sword, Rank, Power, etc...)
- Equip best Pets
- Unlock Island
- Farm Chest

- Change Dash Power
- Farm Boss (Can choose by a dropdown)
- Use Auto power (need boss farm toggle)
- Farm achivement (Farm Dash & Jump, use it with Dash no cooldown)
